consequence.statement: Kafka brokers running Kafka 4.0.0 or newer no longer have the JMXReporter enabled implicitly: unless metrics are enabled in `.spec.kafka.metrics` or JMXReporter is explicitly added in `metric.reporters`, the JMXReporter will not be enabled and JMX metrics will not be exposed.
consequence.remediation: Enable metrics through `.spec.kafka.metricsConfig` in the Kafka custom resource, or explicitly add JMXReporter in `metric.reporters`.

assertion.statement: From Kafka 4.0.0, the JMXReporter is enabled only if metrics are enabled in `.spec.kafka.metrics` (the Kafka custom resource's metrics configuration) or JMXReporter is explicitly added in `metric.reporters`, so a cluster on Kafka 4.0.0 or newer without either no longer has the JMXReporter enabled.
